                                      Resolution 2023-15
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR 35% PROPOSED DESIGN FOR A
    HANGING DECK SUSPENSION BRIDGE CROSSING OF GLACIER CREEK TO
               RECONNECT THE WINNER CREEK TRAIL

   WHEREAS, the Hand Tram was decommissioned after accidents made it clear that the hand tram was unable to safely accommodate
     the volume of hikers on the Winner Creek Trail; and

   WHEREAS, the community has met and discussed solutions to the lack of connectivity to this integral part of the Girdwood trails
    network; and

   WHEREAS, ultimately the Girdwood Trails Committee and Girdwood Land Use Committee recommended that the hand tram be
    replaced with a bridge, which would restore connectivity, provide year-round access, and improve accessibility to all trail users; and

   WHEREAS, in conjunction with the USFS, 35% design for construction of a hanging deck suspension bridge has been presented to
     the community via the Girdwood Trails Committee and the Girdwood Land Use Committee; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Committee accepted the 35% design plan by unanimous consent at their September 5, 2023 Regular
    Meeting; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Land Use Committee accepted the 35% design plan by unanimous consent at their September 11, 2023
    Regular Meeting;

   THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the 35% design plan as presented and looks forward to reviewing the
     project at a higher level of design with a goal of having the project out to bid and under construction as soon as possible.


   PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 4 in favor and 0 opposed this 18th day of September 2023.




    Briana Sullivan                                       Attest
   GBOS Co-Chair
